chatgptPrompt:
Create a 9:16 (1080x1920) Short cover, focal point inside the centre safe area (clear of the bottom 25% and the right edge).
Subject: one human fingertip pad seen close and large, deep warm brown painted skin (about RGB 124, 57, 29), the fingerprint ridges forming a clear whorl, no face.
Composition: the fingertip fills the lower two thirds, rising from the bottom edge, ivory negative space above it for the text.
Lighting and treatment: warm side light, soft depth of field, ivory ground (#F7EFE3), deep green #00685F as the only accent.
Mood: quiet wonder.
Text: "Grown, not drawn." in a navy editorial serif, upper centre.
Scientific accuracy: fingerprint ridges form before birth, spreading in waves from a few starting places on the fingertip; an illustration, not a photograph.
Avoid: no faces, arrows, circles, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real medical photo.
Style: premium medical-editorial documentary illustration, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
